paper_title: Search for axion-like dark matter using solid-state nuclear magnetic resonance
notes: CASPEr-electric solid-state NMR search. Reports |gd|<9.5e-4 GeV^-2 corresponding to oscillating neutron EDM amplitude <1.0e-21 e*cm over 39.1-40.2 MHz (mass ~162-166 neV). Also constrains gradient coupling g_aNN<2.8e-1 GeV^-1 (AxionNeutron). Limit given as a single value across band; only band edges shown as data points. DM density (rho_DM ~3.6e-42 GeV^4 ~ standard 0.4 GeV/cm^3 halo model) assumed. | Vision: Figure 3(a) plots nucleon EDM coupling g_d in GeV^-2 (left axis) and gradient coupling g_aNN (right axis). The text gives g_d < 9.5e-4 GeV^-2 corresponding to d_n < 1.0e-21 e·cm. I converted the plotted g_d boundary to d_n in e·cm using d_n = g_d × (1.0e-21/9.5e-4) ≈ g_d × 1.053e-18. The floor of the exclusion well is at d_n ≈ 9.5e-22 to 1.0e-21 e·cm across 162-166 neV, with steep walls at the edges. X-axis is linear in neV. Confidence reduced because the y-axis is natively g_d (GeV^-2), not d_n directly. | CV calibration unavailable (no plot region), used LLM axes | Calibration: No calibration needed
